subject: Context length profiling & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: rishi@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Context length profiling & pricing follow-up

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + next steps so we can put together a pricing sample that matches your workload: 

Recap from call:
- Primary use case: product docs summarization + executive brief generation and long-form code assist for customers.
- Typical flow: ingest doc -> system prompt + doc chunk(s) -> generation (sometimes chain-of-thought) -> rerank/merge.
- Key constraints: latency target ~ 500–900 ms P95 for short queries; for long-form outputs >10s is acceptable but want predictable cost.

What we need from you to prepare a tailored price/throughput proposal: 
1) Token profiling: avg prompt tokens, avg completion tokens, and a rough distribution of context-length needs (what % of requests are within 8k vs 32k vs 128k).
2) Monthly traffic estimate (requests/month or DAU * avg requests/day) so we can estimate total monthly tokens.
3) Target budget or $/1M-token goal so we can size Hosted vs Dedicated options.

I've attached a simple CSV template (sample_prompts.csv) — if you can drop in a small sample of representative prompts/responses we can run quick tokenization and give you exact averages. If you're comfortable, a ballpark answer in-line works too.

Proposed next steps: 
- If you send the sample CSV, I'll run profiling and follow up with a 2-option pricing sheet (hosted + dedicated) and expected unit economics.
- If you'd prefer a short proof-of-cost, we can run a 2-week pilot on a small reserved pool to measure real tokens and latency (will need an NDA/PO).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: sample_prompts.csv (CSV stub: prompt_text,expected_output_length_tokens,context_type)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@acmerobotics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context length profiling & pricing follow-up

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear notes. Below is what I can share quickly (we'll follow up with the CSV later today):

Token profiling (current stack tooling measured in-house):
- Avg prompt tokens per request: ~1,200 tokens (includes system prompt + selected doc chunks)
- Avg completion tokens per request: ~3,600 tokens (we generate detailed executive briefs and long code patches)
- Avg total tokens per request: ~4,800 tokens

Monthly volume (current pilot -> projected for 12 months with ramp):
- Active users (weekly): ~12,000
- Avg requests/user/day: 0.25 (power users spike to 3 requests/day)
- Estimated requests/month (conservative): 90,000
- Estimated total tokens/month: ~432M tokens/month (90k * 4.8k)

Context-length distribution (approx):
- <=8k context: 72%
- 8k–32k: 23%
- >32k (need up to 128k): 5% (these are large multi-doc syntheses for enterprise customers)

Target budget & unit economics:
- Procurement has given a target budget range: $8k–$12k/month initially for hosted; willing to discuss committed spend for discounts.
- Internal target $/1M tokens: roughly $18–$28/1M tokens (we know this will vary by model, latency SLOs, and context length).

Notes / constraints:
- Security: must support SOC2 and VPC peering (we'll likely push for Private/Dedicated in Q4 if numbers look good).
- Latency: for the 5% heavy-context jobs, latency can be higher but we want predictable queueing/fallbacks.

Happy to sync if you want me to walk through the raw CSV. I can share an anonymized sample of 200 prompts by EOD.

— Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of AI Product, Acme Robotics
olivia@acmerobotics.com | +1 (617) 555-9876

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: rishi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context length profiling & pricing follow-up

Perfect — this is exactly what we need, thanks. Quick notes based on your numbers and what we'd propose next: 

High-level takeaways from your profile: 
- Avg tokens/request (~4.8k) and monthly volume (~432M) put you in a 3–5k $/month spend band on many hosted stacks at retail pricing; with committed discounts and Dedicated options we can get materially lower unit costs.
- Distribution shows majority under 8k but non-trivial 28% requiring 32k+; that suggests we should size a mixed deployment: default 8k-optimized pool + a small 32k/128k-capable pool for heavy jobs.

Initial pricing approach (rough, to align budgets before we run the sample):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): baseline offer target ~$22/1M tokens for mixed workload (this includes buffer for high-memory 32k/128k routing).
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): with a 6–12 month commit we can target $12–$15/1M tokens at your projected volume (depends on model family & any quantization).
- Pilot: 2-week staging run to profile real tokenization and latency. We'll provide a short report with per-route cost and a suggested batching/cache config that could lower your unit cost by ~15–30%.

Attachments: I'm attaching a short pricing sheet (redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf) with example math and a sample tokenization output from a similar customer. If those baseline numbers look in-line with procurement's expectations ($8k–$12k/mo), we can draft a committed reserved plan for you and loop legal/procurement.

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll run your CSV through our profiler and send exact avg prompt/completion tokens + a per-length distribution.
2) We'll propose Hosted and Dedicated price tables and show the $/1M tokens outcome at your 432M/month volume.
3) If agreeable, we can set up a 2-week pilot (we'll need an MSA/NDA/PO for Dedicated trials).

Rishi — can you draft a pilot config (2-node 80GB A100 equiv pool, staging routing rules) and a short note on expected latency and estimated monthly spend at 432M tokens? I'll include that in the SOW draft for Acme.

Thanks — talk soon.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf (stub: pricing scenarios + unit economics examples)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context length profiling & pricing follow-up

Adding to Marissa's note — initial pilot config I'll propose to Acme: 
- Staging pool: 2 reserved NVIDIA A100-80GB equiv nodes (can test quantized int8/Q4 configs).
- Routing: default → 8k-optimized pool; large-context flag → 32k/128k-capable pool with autoscaling to 4 nodes for peak.
- Estimated pilot spend (2 weeks, conservative real-traffic sampling): $3.5k–$5k (we'll meter actual token usage).
- Expected unit economics improvement: with prefix/KV caching + batching we typically see 15–25% token-cost reduction for doc-heavy workloads.

I'll draft the technical appendix and include cost delta scenarios for $12/1M vs $22/1M pricing so procurement can see payback on a commit.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
